import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize sex label variants (FEMALE -> female)
    if 'sex' in df.columns:
        df['sex'] = df['sex'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().lower() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    # fix flipper_length_mm negative sign errors
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
        df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] *= -1
    # fix body_mass_g out-of-range (e.g., 5700000 grams -> 5700 grams)
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
        # iterative safety for extreme values
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        while mask.any():
            df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] /= 1000
            mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        mask_low = df['body_mass_g'] < 2500
        # low values are not present in this sample; keep as NaN if needed
        # df.loc[mask_low, 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species'])
    d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(d['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    grouped = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items() if pd.notna(k)}
